periods.label: 侍奉凛奈的夏洛特

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

status.current: attends Rinna while watching the final

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress whom she translates and cares for.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Politely asks him for sugar while the group is hidden.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Growls when Rinna proposes recruiting him as a butler.

periods.summary: Charlotte accompanies Rinna at the hidden cafe and translates Rinna's dramatic complaints into plain meaning. She wipes Rinna's mouth, asks Tsukikage to pass sugar, and later watches the final from the Akatsuki side. After Rinna says Ikki would suit being her butler, Charlotte growls in opposition.

key_events.summary: Attends Rinna during the hidden cafe meeting.
Reacts protectively to Rinna's interest in recruiting Ikki.

periods.label: 照顾凛奈的侍女

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

status.current: continues serving Rinna and translating her eccentric speech
status.condition: overwhelmed by bathhouse fantasies involving Rinna

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress whom she serves, translates, and dotes on.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Explains to Kanata that Rinna is not a full Rebellion member.

periods.summary: Charlotte attends Ikki's victory party alongside Rinna, wiping sauce from Rinna's face and translating her chuunibyou speech for others. When Kanata confronts Rinna about Rebellion ties, Charlotte clarifies that Rinna joined the Akatsuki operation as a guest because of her relationship with Tsukikage, not as a true Rebellion member. Later, the suggestion of a public bath sends Charlotte into an overheated fantasy about bathing with Rinna.

key_events.summary: Supports and explains Rinna during Kanata's intervention.

periods.label: 护送凛奈进入惨剧现场的随从

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

status.current: at ruined Rebellion headquarters with Rinna and Sara

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress and close companion; helps her step through the corpse-strewn site.

periods.summary: Charlotte arrives at the destroyed Rebellion headquarters with Rinna and Sara. She steps out first, warns Rinna to watch her footing, and supports her through the bloody snow and corpses. She confirms to Rinna that Ikki and Stella had said they were heading to Vermillion, helping connect Tsukikage's vision of Or-Gaule's plan to the immediate danger facing their acquaintances.

key_events.summary: Accompanies Rinna during the investigation and helps identify that Ikki and Stella may be at risk.

periods.time: Two weeks before the final narration, ruined Rebellion headquarters
periods.label: 响应凛奈护卫命令的夏洛特

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

status.current: stands down after Kozo warns that Abraham Carter is unbeatable for them
status.condition: ready to fight before being restrained

personality.summary: Loyal and energetic, immediately answering Rinna's command in English.

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Responds to Rinna's order to protect their fathers.
relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: One of the people she intends to protect.
relationships.abraham-carter: Threat she is told not to engage.

periods.summary: Charlotte appears in the epilogue at the ruined Rebellion headquarters alongside Rinna and Sara. When PSYON arrives, Rinna says they must protect their fathers, and Charlotte answers emphatically, 'YES, My Lord.' She prepares for combat but is ordered to stop by Kozo Kazamatsuri, who says they cannot beat Abraham Carter. The scene leaves her in a defensive but restrained role as Abraham demands Tsukikage and Kozo choose a side.

key_events.summary: Readies herself to protect Kozo's group before standing down.

periods.time: After PSYON leaves the ruined Rebellion headquarters
periods.label: 在雪中等待援军的女仆

name.jp: シャルロット・コルデー

titles: 风祭凛奈的随从兼女仆

status.current: rescued with Rinna's group and assisting Kazamatsuri during Tsukikage's illness
status.condition: survives frostbite and exhaustion after hiding in the Alps

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Mistress; Charlotte remains in the snow to secure help for her.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Sara hides Charlotte with Roadside Ash so PSYON misses her.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Calls and guides him to the Tatra base; he protects her with wind camouflage.
relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Serves the Kazamatsuri household and later reports Tsukikage's condition to him.

periods.summary: When PSYON abducts Kazamatsuri's party, Sara's Roadside Ash keeps Charlotte unnoticed. Charlotte waits in the freezing ruins for Ouma, risking frostbite so she can tell him that the US military took Rinna. Ouma follows her directions to the Tatra base and grants her Heavenly Dragon Armor camouflage so she can infiltrate and rescue the captives while he draws attention. Later she remains with the group during their return through China and reports Tsukikage's worsening condition to Kazamatsuri.

key_events.summary: Survives hidden in the snow and summons Ouma to save Rinna.
Infiltrates under Ouma's wind camouflage while he attacks the base.
Helps monitor Tsukikage during the return journey.

abilities: benefits from Sara's Roadside Ash and Ouma's Heavenly Dragon Armor
